## VantaVault v0.5.34

See how utility changed a round, jump from a fight to its replay, and keep using the shop while a Riot ID is unavailable.

### Highlights

- **Utility in Replay Theater** (utilitystates) — See where Cypher’s wires were placed and triggered, when Killjoy activated her Nanoswarm, and how projectiles moved.
- **Jump from a fight to the replay** (fightreplay) — Open a fight or takeaway from Match Map and check teammate positions before, during, and after the fight.
- **Shop access without a Riot ID** (localaccount) — Open the shop through your signed-in Riot Client session while VantaVault displays an unavailable Riot ID as Unknown.

### Added

- Playback supports VALORANT 13.10 replay files downloaded from the game.
- Replay Theater shows distinct ground effects for mollies, individual Sage wall blocks, and more recorded utility.

### Improved

- The Tactics Board lets you drag agents and utility onto the map, move existing pieces, and reposition routes. Use **Plan from here** to start from the current replay moment.
- **Renew all** retries eligible saved Riot sessions, including accounts that were renewed recently.
- The replay timeline groups simultaneous pieces of the same ability into one entry.

### Fixed

- A missing Riot ID no longer holds up Local Client mode. VantaVault keeps a Riot ID it already knows for that account.
- VantaVault automatically retries when Riot initially returns an empty equipped loadout.

### Download

- **Windows Portable** — `VantaVault-portable.exe`
- **Windows Installer** — `VantaVault_0.5.34_x64-setup.exe`

### Auto-update

Both Windows versions update from inside VantaVault.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/akawazak/valo-project/compare/v0.5.33...v0.5.34)
